title: myCHEF vs Cedar Tree Catering: which is better in 2026
body_markdown:
**Choose myCHEF if you want a vetted chef cooking in your own kitchen, or catering designed around your guest count and menu. Choose Cedar Tree Catering if its published menu and event format already match what you are planning.** This page compares [myCHEF](https://mychef.ae/) and Cedar Tree Catering for Dubai households and businesses in 2026.


**TL;DR**

- myCHEF suits households and hosts who want a vetted chef and a menu designed around them.
- Cedar Tree Catering suits buyers whose event fits its existing menu and service format.
- Mychef vs Cedar Tree Catering is a question of format: bespoke chef service against a catering company's set offer.
- Get written quotes from both with the same date, venue, guest count and dietary list.


## Why this comparison matters in 2026

Private chefs and catering companies get lumped together in Dubai searches, but they solve different problems. A private chef cooks in your kitchen, often on a repeating schedule. A catering company delivers or serves food for an occasion.

myCHEF covers both sides: vetted chefs for home-cooked meals and weekly meal prep, plus dinner parties, corporate events and larger catered celebrations. Cedar Tree Catering is a catering business, and the comparison below is built on the questions that separate providers, not on claims we cannot source.

**A note on evidence.** The facts about myCHEF here come from its own service description. For Cedar Tree Catering, current menus, pricing, staffing and terms must come from Cedar Tree directly. Where this page has no verified fact, it says what to ask instead of guessing.

## At a glance

| Dimension | myCHEF | Cedar Tree Catering |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Home chef service, meal prep, dinner parties, corporate and large events | Buyers who want a catering company's set offer for an event |
| Service range | Chef at home, weekly meal prep, dinner parties, corporate events, celebrations | Confirm current services with Cedar Tree |
| Menu approach | Designed around the client, guest count and dietary needs | Ask whether menus are fixed or adjustable |
| Chef vetting | Chefs are vetted and scored before they cook | Ask how cooks and staff are selected |
| Food standard | Halal-first | Confirm halal status in writing |
| Recurring service | Weekly meal prep and ongoing home cooking | Confirm whether recurring bookings exist |
| Pricing model | Starting prices shared, final quote tailored to the brief | Request a written, itemised quote |
| Standout feature | Kitchen left exactly as it was found | Confirm what setup and cleanup are included |

## myCHEF is the better fit for recurring home cooking

This is the clearest axis of difference. myCHEF provides vetted chefs for home-cooked meals and weekly meal prep, so the same service that covers a one-off dinner also covers a regular week. If you want food made in your kitchen on a repeating schedule, a chef service is the format built for it.

A catering company is organised around events. Some also run regular programmes, so ask Cedar Tree directly whether it takes recurring household bookings. Do not assume it does or does not.

For families weighing the cost of a regular chef, the [private chef cost guide](https://www.mychef.ae/blog/how-much-does-a-private-chef-cost-in-dubai-in) explains what moves the price. Verdict: **myCHEF wins for weekly and monthly home cooking.**

## Menu design: myCHEF builds around you

myCHEF designs menus around the client: the guest count, the occasion, the cuisine and the dietary needs. That means the starting point is your brief, not a menu card.

A caterer with a fixed menu can be a strength. You see what you are buying, the dishes are proven at volume and the decision is quick. It becomes a limit if you have a mixed guest list with allergies, a cultural brief or a specific theme.

Test either provider with the same question: send your real dietary list and ask how each dish changes. The answer tells you how flexible the menu is. Verdict: **myCHEF is the stronger choice for bespoke menus; a fixed-menu caterer can be the faster choice for simple events.**


![Two-column comparison of chef service and catering company across menu, vetting, setup and cleanup](https://media.get-ryze.ai/workspace-article-images-public/a169d7c5-59f0-45de-9a56-39ac38df90b0/body-9fb6deadb50eab272dae3dac49b2e79a.jpg)

*Compare both providers on the same four points before you compare price.*


## Chef vetting and food standards: myCHEF states its position

myCHEF vets and scores chefs before they cook for clients, and works to a halal-first standard. Those are stated policies you can hold the company to in a written quote.

For Cedar Tree Catering, ask three things in writing:

- How are cooks and service staff selected and checked?
- Is all food prepared to a halal standard, and is the kitchen certified?
- Who is accountable on the day if something goes wrong?

For a deeper look at halal options across the city, see the [halal catering roundup](https://www.mychef.ae/blog/best-halal-catering-companies-in-dubai). Verdict: **myCHEF has the clearer stated standard; Cedar Tree can match it only if it confirms the same in writing.**

## Staffing, setup and cleanup: confirm before you compare

This is where two quotes that look similar end up very different. Serving staff, equipment, setup and cleanup can be included, optional or excluded. A lower headline figure often means fewer inclusions, not a better deal.

myCHEF works to leave the kitchen exactly as it was found. For events, ask for staffing levels and service style to be named in the proposal. The guide on [serving staff and cleanup from Dubai caterers](https://www.mychef.ae/blog/can-catering-companies-in-dubai-provide-serving-staff-and-cleanup) lists what to ask.

This is a tie until Cedar Tree's terms are on the table. Verdict: **both can handle it well; the written inclusions decide.**

## Event scale: both can serve, the format differs

myCHEF handles dinner parties, corporate events and large catered celebrations, as well as a quiet dinner for two. One provider across both ends of the scale means the same standards apply whether you are booking a household week or a company event.

A dedicated catering company is often built for volume. If your event is large and the menu is straightforward, that focus is a real advantage, and Cedar Tree may well suit it. Ask for references or sample setups at your guest count.

Verdict: **a tie on scale, with myCHEF stronger on mixed needs and a dedicated caterer potentially stronger on pure volume.**

## Pricing: compare models, not headline figures

This page quotes no prices for either company, because prices change and the only reliable number is the one in your written quote.

The pricing models differ in practice:

- **myCHEF** shares starting prices and tailors the final quote to the brief: guest count, menu, service style and location.
- **A set-menu caterer** typically trades flexibility for predictability, with a per-head figure that is easy to compare. Confirm whether Cedar Tree works this way.

Whichever you choose, ask for an itemised quote that separates food, staffing, equipment, delivery and cleanup. Then compare line by line.

## Scorecard

| Dimension | Winner |
|---|---|
| Recurring home cooking and meal prep | myCHEF |
| Bespoke menu design | myCHEF |
| Stated chef vetting and halal-first standard | myCHEF |
| Staffing, setup and cleanup | Tie, depends on written terms |
| Large event volume | Tie, depends on the brief |
| Pricing clarity | Tie, depends on itemised quotes |

## Choose myCHEF if...

- You want a vetted chef cooking in your home, weekly or for a single dinner.
- Your guest list has dietary needs, a cultural brief or a theme that a set menu will not cover.
- Halal-first preparation and a kitchen left exactly as found matter to you.
- You want one provider for your household and your events.

## Choose Cedar Tree Catering if...

- Its published menu and service format already match your event.
- You want a conventional catering company's offer without designing a menu.
- Its written quote includes the staffing, setup and cleanup you need at a price you prefer.

If you are still shortlisting, the [Cedar Tree Catering alternatives guide](https://www.mychef.ae/blog/cedar-tree-catering-alternatives-in) lays out other options in the same bracket.


**Get a tailored myCHEF quote**

Share your date, location, guest count and the service you need.

**[Request a quote](https://www.mychef.ae/contact)**


## How to run a fair comparison

Send both providers an identical brief. Four lines is enough:

1. Date and time.
2. Venue or home address area, including kitchen access.
3. Guest count with dietary and halal requirements.
4. The service you want: chef at home, meal prep, dinner party or event catering.

Then compare the replies on reply time, clarity of inclusions and how directly each answers your dietary list. A provider that answers precisely before you have paid anything usually works the same way on the day.

## FAQ


**Is myCHEF better than Cedar Tree Catering?**

myCHEF is better for recurring home cooking and bespoke menus. Cedar Tree Catering may suit you better if its set offer matches your event. Compare written quotes on the same brief.

**What is the difference between a private chef and a catering company?**

A private chef cooks in your kitchen, often on a repeating schedule. A catering company prepares and serves food for an event. myCHEF offers both formats.

**Does myCHEF cook halal food?**

Yes. myCHEF works to a halal-first standard. Confirm any specific requirements, such as certification, when you request a quote.

**Are myCHEF chefs vetted?**

Yes. myCHEF vets and scores chefs before they cook for clients. Ask about the chef assigned to your booking when you enquire.

**Can myCHEF cater large events?**

Yes. myCHEF handles dinner parties, corporate events and large catered celebrations. Share the guest count and venue so the proposal can be built around them.

**How should I compare Cedar Tree Catering and myCHEF prices?**

Ask both for an itemised quote covering food, staffing, equipment, delivery and cleanup for the same brief. Compare totals and inclusions, not headline figures.

**Does myCHEF leave the kitchen clean?**

myCHEF works to leave the kitchen exactly as it was found. Confirm cleanup scope for your event in the written proposal.


## One last thing

The cheapest quote is rarely the cheapest booking. Ask each provider one question before you decide: what is not included? The answer shows you the real price and how openly the company talks about it.

To get a myCHEF proposal, [send your date, location, guest count and the service you need](https://www.mychef.ae/contact), and the team will come back with a menu and quote designed around your brief.
